claim: With On-demand Standard, you pay per GB of data written and read. Data-In is billed per GB written into the data stream, calculated as the number of records multiplied by the size of each record rounded up to the nearest 1 KB (1,024 bytes), so a 4.5 KB record counts as 5 KB.

qualifiers.scope: per GB written, On-demand Standard pricing
qualifiers.condition: each record is rounded up to the nearest 1 KB (1,024 bytes)

evidence.quote: With On-demand Standard, you pay per GB of data written and read from your data streams.

Data-In: The data ingested into Kinesis Data Streams is billed per GB written into your data stream. This is calculated as the number of data records you send to the service, multiplied by the size of each record rounded up to the nearest 1 KB (1,024 bytes). For example, if your data records are 4.5 KB each, Kinesis Data Streams will count each record as 5 KB of data ingested.
